figures.caption: Table 2. Datasets and setup. Train trials per subject are given as median (range). Parameter counts are totals, with the share in the head in parentheses. Thresholds are in units of 10−5 and learning rates of 10−3.

Fig. 2. Test accuracy (%) against communication round. Configurations are defined in Table 1. Shaded bands show ±1 std across seeds. Curves run until training stops, whereas Table 3 reports the accuracy at the round of lowest validation loss. Dashed lines give the centralised accuracy from Table 3.

Table 3. Test accuracy (%, mean±std). The last two columns are federated. Configurations are defined in Table 1. Bold marks the best configuration in each row. Chance levels are 25.0 (BNCI2014-001), 14.3 (Weibo2014) and 50.0 (Cho2017).
